headline: Heavy Combat Sweeps Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm
war_summary: Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm remain the war's sharpest battlegrounds, recording seven and nine base events respectively over the last two hours. In Weathered Expanse, where three strategic strongholds now sit reduced to no-man's-land, bitter struggles around Crow's Nest and Wightwalk generated nearly sixteen hundred casualties in two hours alone. Palantine Berm likewise saw rapid swings across The Droll and The Pippeli Stones, leaving one base ruined and another in Colonial hands. Callahan's Passage sustained an immense bloodletting with more than twenty-one hundred casualties in the past two hours as Wardens reasserted full hex control at Crumbling Post. Fresh territorial movement also broke out across neighboring sectors: Stonecradle logged three base transitions involving The Reach and World's End, Dead Lands saw Abandoned Ward fall into neutral ruin amid accelerating reinforcements, and Viper Pit recorded clashes at Blackthroat. In contrast, Callum's Cape and Kuura Strand have quieted substantially following earlier skirmishes, with front-line pressures shifting firmly into central and northern sectors.
